host_tax_details_identity_complete.name: host_tax_details_identity_complete
host_tax_details_identity_complete.value:
("host_tax_details"."entity_type" = 'individual' and "host_tax_details"."legal_name" is not null and "host_tax_details"."date_of_birth_encrypted" is not null)
        or ("host_tax_details"."entity_type" = 'business' and "host_tax_details"."company_name" is not null and "host_tax_details"."company_number" is not null)

bookings_slot_bounded.name: bookings_slot_bounded
bookings_slot_bounded.value: not isempty("bookings"."slot") and not lower_inf("bookings"."slot") and not upper_inf("bookings"."slot")

sessions_meter_monotonic.name: sessions_meter_monotonic
sessions_meter_monotonic.value: "sessions"."meter_stop_wh" is null or "sessions"."meter_start_wh" is null or "sessions"."meter_stop_wh" >= "sessions"."meter_start_wh"
